verdict.rationale: The pack confirms only that an online sign-in exists ('HMRC online services: sign in or set up an account'). It never says what verification that sign-in uses: no credential MFA method, no statement that it avoids biometric liveness, in-person checks or mailed PINs. The only mail reference is a registration letter for employer registration, not a sign-in factor, so the specific capability is unevidenced.
